blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Aimed at relieving the heavy workload of traditional courts by handling environmental cases.
Driven by the necessity for technical and specialized expertise in resolving environmental disputes.
Serves as a mechanism for India to align with international commitments like the Rio Declaration.
Anchored in Article 21 (Right to Life), interpreting the right to life to encompass a clean environment.

blocks.content: • Inspired by the need for specialized expertise in environmental disputes.

items: Article 21 (Right to Life) explicitly covers the fundamental right to a clean environment in competitive exam questions.
International alignment: Linkage between Indian environmental dispute resolution and international frameworks like the Rio Declaration is frequently tested.
The primary purpose of specialized tribunals is to reduce burden on traditional courts and provide expert resolution.
